title: Vanilla FPS
description: VanillaBoost is a lightweight optimization modpack focused on smoother gameplay, higher FPS, and a cleaner Minecraft experience while keeping the vanilla feel intact.
body:
# VanillaBoost

VanillaBoost is a lightweight Minecraft optimization modpack designed to improve FPS, reduce lag, and provide a smoother overall gameplay experience while still keeping the original vanilla feel of Minecraft. The modpack focuses on performance, stability, and useful quality-of-life improvements without changing the core style of the game too much.

Whether you are playing Survival, PvP, Building, Multiplayer, or simply exploring your worlds, VanillaBoost helps your game run cleaner and smoother with better responsiveness and improved performance on both low-end and high-end PCs.

The pack includes carefully selected optimization and utility mods that work together to provide:

* Higher FPS
* Smoother gameplay
* Better chunk loading
* Reduced stuttering
* Improved game stability
* Better memory and resource usage
* Cleaner overall experience

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[FPS COMPARISION](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1697c9d40438270e8539721c7c2fcb8d936b2eb7.png)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

VanillaBoost is made for players who want Minecraft to feel faster and smoother without heavily modifying the vanilla experience. The modpack keeps the game simple, lightweight, and easy to use while still giving noticeable performance improvements.

Features:

* FPS optimization mods
* Lightweight and stable
* Vanilla-friendly experience
* Smooth gameplay
* Better loading performance
* Reduced lag and stutters
* Quality-of-life improvements
* Multiplayer friendly
* Beginner friendly
* Clean and simple setup

Thank you for downloading and using VanillaBoost ❤️
